messages:
sarah: seeing a spike of 503s on console graphs for multiple customers, started ~08:12 UTC. root error from analytics API: `prefetch timeout` and `upstream 503`.

mike: can you paste a sample request/trace id?

sarah: trace id `trace-0a1b2c3d`; console logs show `GET /v1/query -> 503 (prefetch_timeout)`. snippet:
```json
{"trace_id":"trace-0a1b2c3d","error":"prefetch timeout","shard":"kv-cache-3","lat_ms":1200}
```

jen: noted. are these dashboards using large time ranges or high series fanout?

sarah: yes, top customers hitting heavy fanout (200+ subqueries). we saw CPU on analytics nodes normal, but kv-cache miss rate shot up.

analytics-svc: automated alert: analytics-query-latency > 1s, 503s rate 6% in last 5m. check routing/batch-config.

mike: oncall runbook step 2 — try toggling prefetch=off for the request path. sarah can you repro with `?prefetch=false`?

sarah: tried adding param, graphs load (with higher latency) and no 503s. so prefetch path is failing under high fanout.

nishant: this smells like the pre-warm / kv-cache race. recent runtime change (PR #4571) adjusted prefetch backoff. @eng-runtime can you check the roll?

jen: adding eng-runtime. we should debounce customer-facing workaround: set prefetch default to `false` for heavy routes and roll a hotfix.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-042 "console graphs 503s - prefetch timeout" assigned to eng-runtime.

mike: collecting sample logs + full traces and affected customer ids. sarah pls upload to the incident thread.

sarah: uploaded logs to https://redwood-incident/INC-2026-042 with trace list. also note billing spike tickets from these customers around same time.

mike: thanks. short-term mitigation: toggle global prefetch gate for dashboards to off for 30m. i'll coordinate with infra.

jen: long-term: rollback PR #4571 or add backpressure in prefetch. eng-runtime prioritize P0.

sarah: ping me when mitigation is live, i'll confirm with customers.

mike: mitigation applied at 08:27 UTC, gate set to off. monitoring: 503s fell to 0.5% in 5m window.

sarah: confirmed dashboards recovered. closing the support alert once eng-runtime PR is in.

nishant: adding follow-up task: add more robust metrics around prefetch queue depth and per-shard backpressure.

analytics-svc: automation note: will mute alert for 30m.

sarah: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
